import os
import sys
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from PIL import Image
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.optim as optim
from torchvision import transforms, models
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Set device
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
print(f"Using device: {device}")

# Define base image directory globally
base_img_dir = "./input/images/"


class PlantPathologyDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, image_paths, ids, transform=None):
        self.image_paths = image_paths
        self.ids = ids
        self.transform = transform

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.ids)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        img_path = self.image_paths[idx]
        image = Image.open(img_path).convert("RGB")
        if self.transform:
            image = self.transform(image)
        return image, self.ids[idx]


transform_train = transforms.Compose(
    [
        transforms.Resize((224, 224)),
        transforms.ToTensor(),
        transforms.Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
    ]
)

    )

    extracted_dim = sample_model(backbone_features(dummy_tensor))
    return extracted_dim.shape[1]


def load_data():
    sample_sub_path = "./input/sample_submission.csv"
    if os.path.exists(sample_sub_path):
        subsample = pd.read_csv(sample_sub_path)
        sub_cols = subsample.columns.tolist()
    else:
        sub_cols = ["image_id", "healthy", "multiple_diseases", "rust", "scab"]

    train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
    test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

    cols_to_predict = sub_cols[1:]
    X_train = train_df[cols_to_predict].values.astype(np.float32)
    y_train_onehot = train_df[cols_to_predict].astype(int).values

    train_ids = train_df["image_id"].tolist()
    test_ids = test_df["image_id"].tolist()

    return train_df, test_df, X_train, y_train_onehot, train_ids, test_ids, sub_cols


class PlantPathologyModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes):
        super().__init__()
        self.backbone = models.mobilenet_v2(
            weights=models.MobileNet_V2_Weights.IMAGENET1K_V2
        )
        self.features = nn.Sequential(*list(self.backbone.features.children()))
        # Adjust dropout rate
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(p=0.3)
        self.classifier = nn.Linear(1280, num_classes)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.features(x)
        x = x.mean(dim=-1)
        x = self.dropout(x)
        return self.classifier(x)


try:
    from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
except ImportError:
    raise ImportError("sklearn installed. Run: pip install scikit-learn")


def compute_mean_column_roc_auc(y_true, y_pred, num_labels):
    scores_list = []
    for i in range(num_labels):
        mask = y_true[:, i : i + 1].flatten().astype(bool)
        if len(mask) > 0 and mask.sum() > 0 and mask.sum() < len(mask):
            score = roc_auc_score(mask, y_pred[:, i])
            scores_list.append(score)
    return np.mean(scores_list) if scores_list else 0.0


train_df, test_df, X_train_full, y_train_full, train_ids, test_ids, sub_cols = (
    load_data()
)
num_classes = len(sub_cols) - 1
print(f"Classes: {sub_cols[1:]}")
print(f"Training samples: {len(X_train_full)}, Test images: {len(test_ids)}")

# Create hold-out split (not used in training at all)
val_ratio = 0.2
split_idx = int(len(X_train_full) * (1 - val_ratio))
X_train_split = X_train_full[:split_idx]
y_train_split = y_train_full[:split_idx]
train_ids_split = train_ids[:split_idx]
train_images = [os.path.join(base_img_dir, f"{iid}.jpg") for iid in train_ids_split]

X_val_split = X_train_full[split_idx:]
y_val_split = y_train_full[split_idx:]
val_ids_split = train_ids_split[split_idx:]
val_images = [
    os.path.join(base_img_dir, f"{iid}.jpg") for iid in train_ids_split[split_idx:]
]

print(f"Train: {len(X_train_split)}, Val: {len(X_val_split)}")

model = PlantPathologyModel(num_classes)
criterion = nn.BCEWithLogitsLoss(reduction="none")
optimizer = optim.Adam(filter(lambda p: p.requires_grad, model.parameters()), lr=1e-3)

train_dataset = PlantPathologyDataset(
    train_images, train_ids_split, transform=transform_train
)
val_dataset = PlantPathologyDataset(
    val_images, val_ids_split, transform=transform_train
)

train_loader = DataLoader(train_dataset, batch_size=32, shuffle=True, drop_last=False)
val_loader = DataLoader(val_dataset, batch_size=32, shuffle=False, drop_last=False)

best_auc = 0.0
best_model_state = None
patience = 20
no_improve = 0
epochs = 100

for epoch in range(epochs):
    model.train()
    train_loss = []
    for imgs, _ in train_loader:
        preds = model(imgs.to(device))
        loss = criterion(preds, y_train_split.to(device)).mean()
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()
        train_loss.append(loss.item())

    model.eval()
    val_preds_list = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for imgs, _ in val_loader:
            preds = model(imgs.to(device))
            val_preds_list.extend(preds.cpu().numpy())

    val_preds_array = np.array(val_preds_list)
    val_scores = compute_mean_column_roc_auc(
        y_val_split.numpy(), val_preds_array, num_classes
    )

    if val_scores >= best_auc:
        best_auc = val_scores
        best_model_state = {k: v.cpu() for k, v in model.state_dict().items()}
        no_improve = 0
    else:
        no_improve += 1

    if no_improve >= patience:
        print(f"Early stopping at epoch {epoch+1}")
        break

    print(f"Epoch {epoch+1}, Val Mean-AUC: {val_scores:.6f} | Best: {best_auc:.6f}")

if best_model_state is not None:
    model.load_state_dict(best_model_state)

test_images = [os.path.join(base_img_dir, f"{iid}.jpg") for iid in test_ids]
test_dataset = PlantPathologyDataset(test_images, test_ids, transform=transform_train)
test_loader = DataLoader(test_dataset, batch_size=32, shuffle=False)

final_preds = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for imgs, _ in test_loader:
        preds = model(imgs.to(device))
        final_preds.extend(preds.cpu().numpy())

final_preds = np.column_stack(final_preds)
final_probs = pd.DataFrame(final_preds, columns=sub_cols[1:])
final_probs["image_id"] = test_ids

final_probs = final_probs.sort_values("image_id").reset_index(drop=True)
final_probs.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("\nSubmission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")

print(
    f"\nFinal Model Validation Metric (Mean Column-Wise ROC AUC on hold-out validation): {best_auc:.6f}"
)
